cases.name: empty
one put is the head of its path
a chain of saves: newest is head, the rest superseded oldest first, not diverged
two saves from the same prev: newer is head, older superseded, diverged
a created_at tie breaks on event id; a head with prev null over an open op is diverged
a delete after a put is the head
a move is the head of both its path and its destination
a put at a move's destination builds on the move there and leaves the move as head at the source
a record closes the drafts it names, leaves the others open, and a later put on the same path is a fresh head
closing a superseded op leaves the head that built on it open and not diverged
records list newest first and may name ids the fold never saw
another repository's op is counted, not folded; malformed, mis-kinded and mis-scoped ops are ignored
a case-variant a tag folds as its canonical coordinate (ingest never stores one; a reader must not drop it)
duplicate ids keep the first
paths sort bytewise regardless of op order
an asset put is the head of its path and reports sha256, mime and size
a document and its asset are separate paths
re-uploading an image supersedes the first asset put
a folder keep is an ordinary path with an ordinary head
a document move names both ends
